name: Finality
source:
A short story about the tale of an immortal coming to terms with the end of it all. 

"Everything has an end, every story, every life, every sentence. It has a beginning and an end. The end doesn't always have to be a bad thing. The end means something completed its purpose, in some strange way or another."

[from [url=https://xenubinstudios.itch.io/finality]itch.io[/url]]
